prompts.prompt: Image 1 is a KakaoTalk chat screenshot. Create a realistic amateur photo, taken with a second phone, of a person's hand holding a modern iPhone upright that displays exactly the chat in image 1, in the same casual photographic style as image 2. The whole phone is visible except the bottom edge may be cut off; the phone fills about 85% of the frame; slightly tilted; blurry room background with a desk and warm indoor light. The screen shows the light blue-gray KakaoTalk background with the same yellow bubbles on the right, white bubbles on the left, the same gym door photo, the same timestamps and the same Korean text and line breaks as image 1, nothing added, no bubble repeated. Add subtle real-photo artifacts: slight moire on the screen, faint glare, fingerprint smudges, phone camera noise. No other text, no watermark.
